purpose: Select one assignment-independent vtree from a frozen polynomial proof-carrying portfolio using full bounded C039 probes.
constructive_meta_theorem: For a polynomial-size deterministic candidate portfolio and polynomially budgeted C039 probes, selecting the least-cost candidate with a replayable CLOSED_POLY certificate is polynomial and sound.
compiler_capability_ladder: C039.3 low-affine-dimension Horn/dual-Horn plus affine composition
capability_evolution_rule: Adding or changing any compiler implementation changes the capability digest and makes earlier OPEN_PORTFOLIO_EXHAUSTED records stale.
phase_order: run one full bounded C039 probe per candidate
select by deterministic certified cost tuple
immediate_priority: integrate PR #55 / C039.2 into the C039 operation envelope
integrate PR #56 / C039.3 as a mixed-language probe capability
rerun the frozen C040 portfolio under the enlarged capability digest
open C041 only on the resulting exact OPEN frontier
forbidden_promotions: candidate generation after observing probe results
partial or sampled probe promoted to success
hidden communication rows or truth tables
similarity or reduction used to transfer OPEN
finite fixtures used as universal completeness evidence
portfolio failure attributed to discovery before compiler capability is fixed
numbering_note: C039.2 is single-head Horn projection. The low-affine-dimension cross-language composer is canonically C039.3; its c040 branch, executable and wire-schema names are replay aliases. C040 is reserved for charged semantic-vtree discovery.
claim_boundary: Sound selection over a fixed polynomial portfolio and fixed compiler capability only; universal candidate completeness, arbitrary SAT and P versus NP remain open.
